title: Can Claude send me Friday news every week?
text: Someone assumes a Friday brief means outside market news delivered each week. It doesn't. It's your own numbers, revenue against last week, top sellers, wins, and watches over the past 7 or 14 days.

title: A skill is a folder
text: This kind of brief is built from something called a skill, a folder Claude reads before it works. Inside is one file written in plain language that spells out exactly what this weekly check covers. Claude reads the file, then follows it. The file is the whole program.

title: How it runs
text: The steps run in order, read the file, work through each step exactly as written, then return the result. Nothing runs out of sequence unless a step itself says so.

title: Exactly four fields
text: For this skill, the pulse covers exactly four things: revenue measured against the week before, top sellers, wins, and watches, items worth keeping an eye on. The look-back window can widen from 7 days to 14, but that's the only knob. Ask it about anything outside those four things, and there's no mode that covers it.
